name: Financial Model Variant 4
task:
Please complete the following four-stage financial analysis task.

A delivery truck purchase: $60,000. Annual fuel savings: $8,000. Maintenance: $2,000/year. Resale after 8 years: $10,000.

Calculate NPV at 8% and 12% discount rates.

Vary key parameters by ±20%.

Should the investment proceed?
